run_starlette_app: run the starlette app with gzip middleware and optional cors for pipeline inference
get_pipeline: get a cached pipeline instance by task name and model id from environment variables
configure_allowed_tasks: configure the allowed tasks dictionary to map task names to pipeline classes
setup_startup_event: setup the startup event to configure uvicorn logging and initialize the pipeline
add_cors_middleware: add cors middleware to the starlette app when debug mode is enabled
